description: This file contains MLflow-related functions to load models and apply them to pandas-on-Spark dataframes, including a wrapper class for MLflow models and a function to load models.

classes.name: PythonModelWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around MLflow's Python object model for use with pandas-on-Spark, providing prediction methods and model loading.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PythonModelWrapper with model URI and return type hint.

methods.name: _return_type
methods.description: Determines the Spark DataType for the model's return value based on the hint.

methods.name: _model
methods.description: Loads the MLflow pyfunc model from the specified URI.

methods.name: _model_udf
methods.description: Creates a Spark UDF for the model prediction.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Performs prediction on pandas DataFrame or pandas-on-Spark DataFrame.
